description: Emily Dievendorf is running for state representative in Michigan's 77th state house district. She has 20+ years of leadership, organizing and advocacy experience she will bring to her role as a legislator, including work on issues related to LGBTQIA equality, racial justice and equality, sexual and domestic violence, women’s rights, and ending HIV/AIDS.
